ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are several connected hexagons, and black dots represent vertices. Beside the lower-left nearby vertex of the left hexagon is marked 1; beside the upper-right nearby vertex of the upper middle hexagon is marked 4; beside the rightmost vertex of the right hexagon is marked x. The hexagons share some edges or vertices, and all black dots are connected by hexagon sides into one graph. Reasoning: Regard each hexagon side as an edge connecting two vertices. The problem requires that the sum of the numbers on the two endpoint vertices of each edge all be equal; let this common sum be S. Therefore, when moving along adjacent vertices, the numbers alternate between two complementary values. From the figure, one can move along hexagon sides from the vertex marked 1 to the vertex marked 4, and the path length is an odd number of edges, so 1 and 4 belong to opposite alternating classes; they should be complementary, hence S = 1 + 4 = 5. Then moving from the vertex marked 4 along the upper and right hexagon sides to x also passes through an odd number of edges, so x and 4 are complementary. Therefore x = 5 - 4 = 1.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a connected graph of hexagon sides with numbers at the black-dot vertices. From the text, interpret the rule as: for every side/edge of any hexagon, the two endpoint numbers have the same fixed sum. Therefore adjacent vertices must alternate between two complementary values. In the image, trace a side-to-side path from the vertex labeled 1 on the lower-left hexagon to the vertex labeled 4 near the top hexagon; the path has an odd number of edges, so these two vertices are in opposite alternation classes. Hence the common edge sum is 1 + 4 = 5. Then trace from the 4 vertex to the far-right vertex marked x along the top/right hexagon sides; this is also an odd number of edges, so x is complementary to 4 and must be 5 - 4 = 1.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有几个相连的六边形，黑点表示顶点。左侧六边形的左下附近顶点旁标着 1；上方中间六边形的上右附近顶点旁标着 4；右侧六边形最右边的顶点旁标着 x。六边形之间共用部分边或顶点，所有黑点由六边形边连接成一个图。
推理：把每条六边形边看成连接两个顶点的边。题目要求每条边两端顶点上的数字之和都相等，设这个公共和为 S。因此沿着相邻顶点走时，数字会在两个互补值之间交替。由图可沿六边形边从标有 1 的顶点走到标有 4 的顶点，路径长度为奇数条边，所以 1 和 4 属于相反的交替类，它们应互补，故 S = 1 + 4 = 5。再从标有 4 的顶点沿上方和右侧六边形边走到 x，也经过奇数条边，所以 x 与 4 互补。因此 x = 5 - 4 = 1。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct graph-parity/alternation route based on equal sums on every side. It uses parity of paths in the hexagon-side graph rather than setting up many algebraic variables.
planner_metadata.image_role: The image supplies the hexagon-side graph, the locations of the given numbers 1 and 4, and the location of x. It also lets the solver count edge-step parity between these marked vertices.
planner_metadata.text_role: The text supplies the rule that the sum of the numbers at the two corners of each hexagon side is equal, and asks for the value at x.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the rule that if every adjacent pair in a connected graph has the same sum, then values alternate between two complementary numbers along edges; vertices an even number of edges apart have the same value, and vertices an odd number apart have complementary values.
